children: TCGX Acquisition Corp. reported results for the period May 26–June 30, 2026, recording a net loss of $(67,614) and diluted loss per Class B ordinary share of $(0.04). The company remains a blank-check vehicle and had no operating revenues prior to a business combination.
Net income: $(67,614) for the period May 26–June 30, 2026 (net loss).
Diluted EPS: $(0.04) per Class B ordinary share for May 26–June 30, 2026 (basic and diluted).
Business purpose: Formed as a Cayman Islands blank-check company to complete a Business Combination targeting one or more operating businesses.
Operational activity: To date activities have been limited to formation, IPO preparation and target identification; the company had no operating revenues prior to a Business Combination.
Capital deployment focus: Plans to use trust-held proceeds to fund acquisitions, target operations and growth following a Business Combination.
Ongoing costs & readiness: Incurs public-company and due diligence costs while maintaining working capital outside the trust to support transaction execution.
